title: The distro first screen answers the provider search — famous names on the public README/USERGUIDE (v0.2.2-true copy)
body:
## The gap (the vocabulary wall, public side)

The destination lane (#103) fixed the funnel INSIDE the app. But the owner's product concern started at the front door: a regular user searches "Backblaze", "Nextcloud", "Wasabi" and today the PUBLIC IUM-dist README never answers them — its S3 rows name only "AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Wasabi", and Nextcloud appears nowhere.

## Scope (v0.2.2-TRUE copy only)

The shipped product is v0.2.2 (bf594c2, 2026-11-10). The provider picker + share link (#103) exist only on main — they ship in v0.2.3. So the public surface may name providers but must NOT describe the picker or share links:

1. **README hero** — name the famous providers: Backblaze B2, Cloudflare R2, Wasabi, Scaleway, DigitalOcean Spaces, Filebase, AWS S3, MinIO ("anything else speaking the S3 API"), Nextcloud under WebDAV, and the existing lanes.
2. **Highlights** "Every destination, one form" — same expansion.
3. **Transports table** — S3 row notes get the full famous set; WebDAV row notes gain "Nextcloud, ownCloud, any WebDAV server".
4. **USERGUIDE §5 step 3** — the Adapter line lists the same S3 provider set.

Every claim is true for the DOWNLOADABLE build today: the raw-URL S3 lane already reaches every named provider, Nextcloud IS WebDAV, and the v0.2.2 vault ships the TeraBox / MEGA (rclone bridge) / Feishu lanes (verified at the tag). Feishu stays listed — the #56 vault-only doctrine bars NEW Feishu integration lanes, not the shipped adapter.

## Verification bar

- Unauth raw fetch of both files: every famous name present.
- Hygiene: zero internal refs (no issue numbers, no private-repo names) — the #102 gate posture applies to copy, not just assets.
- Markdown structure intact (tables render).
- The private repo's README/USERGUIDE already carry the picker wording — untouched; the two surfaces intentionally diverge until v0.2.3 ships.

## Acceptance

- [ ] issue-first (this)
- [ ] distro README hero + highlights + transports rows
- [ ] distro USERGUIDE adapter line
- [ ] unauth verification + hygiene pass
- [ ] STATUS row (the distro commit SHAs on record)
